title: Ultra Running Split
author: Zeke W.
desc: The Ultra Running Split is an 18-week program designed to elevate your endurance and prepare you for long-distance challenges. With five training days each week, you'll build strength and stamina through a balanced mix of distance runs, speed work, and recovery sessions. This structured approach ensures you progressively enhance your performance while minimizing the risk of injury. Lace up and get ready to push your limits as you conquer the trails and achieve your ultra-running goals!
